title: Conflicting accounts of who sent Puharich to Israel (foundation vs CIA)
summary: Greg tells of Conflicting accounts of who sent Puharich to Israel (foundation vs CIA), about 1970–1971 at Tel Aviv, Israel, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And then Geller himself said, oh, yeah, no, he he was sent by the CIA, like directly.

plain: A researcher named Greg tells of a disagreement over why Andrija Puharich, a scientist who studied psychic claims, went to Tel Aviv, Israel, around 1970 and 1971. One account says a foundation sent him, but Greg says that Uri Geller, an Israeli man known for claiming psychic powers, said Puharich was sent directly by the CIA, the US spy agency. If Geller is right, it would mean American intelligence was behind that work.
